```python
script = '''\
import fitz
import pytesseract
from PIL import Image
import io
import json

pdf_path = "uploads/handbook.pdf"
doc = fitz.open(pdf_path)

# --- Part 1: Extract embedded text from ALL pages ---
all_text = []
for i, page in enumerate(doc):
    text = page.get_text()
    all_text.append({"page": i + 1, "text": text})

# --- Part 2: OCR on the first page image ---
first_page = doc[0]
# Render at 300 DPI for good OCR quality
mat = fitz.Matrix(300 / 72, 300 / 72)
pix = first_page.get_pixmap(matrix=mat)
img_bytes = pix.tobytes("png")
img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(img_bytes))
img.save("first_page.png")
ocr_text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img)

doc.close()

print("=" * 60)
print("EXTRACTED TEXT (all pages)")
print("=" * 60)
for entry in all_text:
    print(f"\\n--- Page {entry['page']} ---")
    print(entry['text'][:3000] if len(entry['text']) > 3000 else entry['text'])

print("\\n" + "=" * 60)
print("OCR TEXT (first page)")
print("=" * 60)
print(ocr_text)

print(f"\\nTotal pages: {len(all_text)}")
print(f"OCR text length: {len(ocr_text)} chars")
'''
await write_file("./extract_pdf.py", script)
print("Script written.")

result = await run_command("python ./extract_pdf.py")
print(result)
```
